name: Sell4me
description: Multi-tenant commerce: merchant dashboard API, hosted storefront API, checkout and payments, POS, help desk.

resources.name: profiles
resources.description: What Sell4me kept on the user (identity itself is Akountz's): name, avatar, timezone, last store, onboarding survey.

resources.name: sandbox_charges
resources.description: Charges of the offline sandbox payment provider (development and demos only). Rows, not process memory: functions run in separate workers.

routes.name: account.accept_invitation
routes.description: Accept a staff invitation with its token (the signed-in user joins the store)

routes.name: account.me
routes.description: The signed-in user, their profile and the stores they work in

routes.name: account.update_profile
routes.description: Update the signed-in user's profile

routes.name: account.switch_store
routes.description: Make a store the one a return visit lands in

routes.name: analytics.overview
routes.description: Headline numbers, the series and top products for a window

routes.name: analytics.customers
routes.description: Who is buying and whether they come back. Repeat rate is computed over the *window*: over all time it would flatter every store

routes.name: analytics.products
routes.description: Product performance for a window

routes.name: analytics.sales
routes.description: Sales broken down by source, status and payment provider

routes.name: analytics.series
routes.description: One metric's daily series (revenue, orders, ...)

routes.name: api.discounts
routes.description: List discounts (scope `discounts.read`)

routes.name: api.discount_create
routes.description: Create a discount code (scope `discounts.manage`)

routes.name: api.me
routes.description: What this key is and what it can do: the first call an integrator makes

routes.name: api.orders
routes.description: List orders: keyset pagination (starting_after), because an offset walks the table and shifts under a caller when an order arrives (scope `orders.read`)

routes.name: api.order
routes.description: One order (scope `orders.read`)

routes.name: api.order_cancel
routes.description: Cancel an order (stock is released; a paid order must be refunded instead) (scope `orders.cancel`)

routes.name: api.order_deliver
routes.description: Mark a shipped order delivered (scope `orders.fulfil`)

routes.name: api.order_fulfil
routes.description: Mark a paid order shipped (scope `orders.fulfil`)

routes.name: api.products
routes.description: List products (scope `products.read`)

routes.name: api.product_create
routes.description: Create a product with its default variant (scope `products.create`)

routes.name: api.product_archive
routes.description: Archive a product: matches the dashboard's delete, and nothing with order history behind it is ever hard-deleted (scope `products.delete`)

routes.name: api.product
routes.description: One product (scope `products.read`)

routes.name: api.product_update
routes.description: Update a product (price, stock and SKU act on the default variant) (scope `products.update`)

routes.name: collections.list
routes.description: List collections with product counts and the product picker's options

routes.name: collections.save
routes.description: Create or update a collection (manual or automatic)

routes.name: images.delete
routes.description: Remove an image and everything derived from it

routes.name: inventory.list
routes.description: Stock levels per variant (all, low, out, tracked)

routes.name: inventory.adjust
routes.description: Adjust one variant's stock, by delta or to an absolute count, with a reason

routes.name: products.options
routes.description: What the product form needs: collections

routes.name: products.list
routes.description: List products (status, search, paging)

routes.name: products.create
routes.description: Create a product

routes.name: products.show
routes.description: One product: details, variants, and its 30-day performance and stock movements

routes.name: products.update
routes.description: Update a product

routes.name: products.archive
routes.description: Archive a product (never a hard delete: order lines point at it)

routes.name: images.upload
routes.description: Upload a product image (base64); derivatives are made by a queued job

routes.name: images.reorder
routes.description: Set the display order from a list of image ids

routes.name: images.status
routes.description: Which images have finished being resized (the uploader polls this)

routes.name: abandoned.list
routes.description: Abandoned carts with recovery links and status counts

routes.name: abandoned.notify
routes.description: Send the recovery email now (and mark the cart followed up)

routes.name: customers.list
routes.description: List customers: search, segment, sort, paging

routes.name: customers.show
routes.description: One customer: profile, addresses, the segments they are in, order and abandoned-cart history

routes.name: customers.update
routes.description: Edit a customer

routes.name: segments.list
routes.description: Segments with live counts, and the rule builder's fields and operators

routes.name: segments.save
routes.description: Create or update a segment (built-in segments are read-only)

routes.name: segments.delete
routes.description: Delete a segment (built-in segments cannot be deleted)

routes.name: segments.members
routes.description: The customers in one segment (resolved live)

routes.name: dashboard.overview
routes.description: The morning screen: store, period, what needs attention, onboarding, recent orders, headline numbers, series, top products

routes.name: designs.list
routes.description: Saved designs and the canvas presets

routes.name: designs.create
routes.description: Start a design

routes.name: designs.delete
routes.description: Delete a design

routes.name: designs.show
routes.description: The editor's payload: the document, products with real prices, valid coupons

routes.name: designs.save
routes.description: Save a design (document size-capped, thumbnail validated)

routes.name: designs.duplicate
routes.description: Copy a design

routes.name: developers.overview
routes.description: API keys (prefix only), webhooks, and what can be subscribed to

routes.name: developers.create_key
routes.description: Mint an API key (the plaintext is returned exactly once)

routes.name: developers.revoke_key
routes.description: Revoke an API key

routes.name: developers.webhook_logs
routes.description: Every delivery attempt, so a merchant can debug their own endpoint ('delivered on the fourth try, 90 seconds late' is a different fact from 'delivered')

routes.name: mail.preview
routes.description: Render any email template against a sample context, without placing an order to trigger one

routes.name: developers.save_webhook
routes.description: Create or update a webhook endpoint (the signing secret is returned once, on creation)

routes.name: developers.delete_webhook
routes.description: Remove a webhook endpoint

routes.name: developers.test_webhook
routes.description: Send a synthetic event through the real delivery path

routes.name: exports.list
routes.description: Recent exports and what can be exported

routes.name: exports.request
routes.description: Queue an export. The permission for the *resource* is checked too: `reports.export` alone must not let a marketing member export the customer list by naming it

routes.name: exports.download
routes.description: A short-lived signed URL for a finished export (the files hold customer names, emails and addresses, so the tenant scope and permission are checked first)

routes.name: finance.overview
routes.description: The financial dashboard: ledger summary, payment counts, series, recent entries and payouts

routes.name: finance.fees
routes.description: Where the money went: platform and provider fees itemised per order (a single total is not a number a merchant can check)

routes.name: finance.ledger
routes.description: The ledger entries (every movement of money), paged

routes.name: finance.payouts
routes.description: Settlements to the merchant's bank (platform-initiated, one per confirmed order)

routes.name: payouts.banks
routes.description: The bank list and this store's connected payout account

routes.name: payouts.connect
routes.description: Connect the bank account payouts are sent to (resolved, then a Paystack subaccount and transfer recipient are created)

routes.name: finance.providers
routes.description: Payment providers: the catalogue and this store's (masked) connections

routes.name: finance.provider_connect
routes.description: Save a provider's credentials, then prove they work

routes.name: finance.provider_default
routes.description: Make a connected provider the default

routes.name: finance.provider_disconnect
routes.description: Remove a provider's credentials (the row stays: payments point at it)

routes.name: finance.provider_verify
routes.description: Re-check a connected provider's keys

routes.name: finance.refunds
routes.description: Refunds issued

routes.name: finance.transactions
routes.description: Transactions: status tabs, search, paging

routes.name: campaigns.list
routes.description: List campaigns with status counts and the pickers' options

routes.name: campaigns.save
routes.description: Create or update a campaign

routes.name: campaigns.show
routes.description: One campaign with refreshed results, redemptions and audience size

routes.name: campaigns.status
routes.description: Start, pause, resume or finish a campaign (the allowed moves are declared, not inferred)

routes.name: discounts.list
routes.description: List discounts with state counts and the pickers' options

routes.name: discounts.save
routes.description: Create or update a discount (percentage, fixed amount, free shipping; automatic or by code)

routes.name: discounts.toggle
routes.description: Enable or disable a discount

routes.name: notifications.list
routes.description: The notification centre, filtered *in the query path* by permission (a payment failure is not for the inventory clerk), so an unauthorised one never leaves the server

routes.name: notifications.read
routes.description: Mark one notification (id) or every one read

routes.name: onboarding.options
routes.description: What the create-store wizard offers: templates, categories, currencies

routes.name: onboarding.check_slug
routes.description: Whether a store address is free

routes.name: onboarding.create_store
routes.description: Create a store and everything it needs to function

routes.name: orders.list
routes.description: List orders: tabs (all, pending, paid, fulfilled, cancelled, refunded), search, paging

routes.name: orders.show
routes.description: One order: lines, addresses, payments, refunds, timeline, risk

routes.name: orders.cancel
routes.description: Cancel an order and return its stock (does not refund: taking money back is a separate decision with its own permission)

routes.name: orders.deliver
routes.description: Mark an order delivered

routes.name: orders.fulfil
routes.description: Mark an order shipped, with tracking

routes.name: orders.note
routes.description: Save an order's note (also a timeline entry)

routes.name: orders.refund
routes.description: Refund some or all of an order; the amount is recomputed from the lines the merchant chose

routes.name: pos.index
routes.description: The POS hub: the open session, recent POS sales, devices

routes.name: pos.config
routes.description: POS configuration: devices, receipt settings, custom domains

routes.name: pos.device_save
routes.description: Create or update a POS device

routes.name: pos.device_delete
routes.description: Remove a device (marks it inactive)

routes.name: pos.device_verify
routes.description: Check a POS device domain's ownership TXT record

routes.name: pos.customer_search
routes.description: Terminal customer lookup by email

routes.name: pos.sale
routes.description: Create a POS order and (for cash) record the payment in one step; for card, creates the pending order that /pos/sale/card/start then charges

routes.name: pos.card_start
routes.description: Start a card charge for a pending POS order (returns the provider's payment URL)

routes.name: pos.product_search
routes.description: Terminal product search by title, SKU or barcode

routes.name: pos.sessions
routes.description: Cashier sessions, most recent first

routes.name: pos.session_open
routes.description: Open a cashier session (a device cannot have two open)

routes.name: pos.session_show
routes.description: End-of-day report for one session

routes.name: pos.session_close
routes.description: Close a session: expected cash, variance and per-variant totals are computed from every order in it

routes.name: pos.terminal
routes.description: Everything the full-screen terminal needs: the quick grid, manual discounts, the open session, the card public key, and (with ?device=) the device

routes.name: search
routes.description: The command palette's query: one endpoint across five resources, five rows each. The cap is the design: a hundred results means the merchant belongs on a list page

routes.name: audit.list
routes.description: Who did what: read-only (there is no endpoint that edits or deletes a row, which is the log's entire value)

routes.name: settings.onboarding
routes.description: The setup checklist with each step's real state

routes.name: team.roles
routes.description: The roles-and-permissions grid, built from the table the guard reads

routes.name: settings.general
routes.description: Store settings, the onboarding checklist and what is locked

routes.name: settings.save
routes.description: Save store settings

routes.name: settings.help_desk
routes.description: Turn the storefront's help desk widget on or off

routes.name: settings.launch
routes.description: Open the store to the public (refuses with what is still to do)

routes.name: settings.maintenance
routes.description: Turn maintenance mode on or off and set what shoppers are told

routes.name: shipping.list
routes.description: Shipping zones and their rates

routes.name: shipping.save_zone
routes.description: Save a shipping zone and its rates (rates are replaced wholesale for the zone being saved; no other zone is touched)

routes.name: shipping.delete_zone
routes.description: Delete a shipping zone and its rates

routes.name: team.list
routes.description: Members, open invitations and the roles on offer

routes.name: team.invite
routes.description: Invite someone to the store (cannot invite above your own reach)

routes.name: team.revoke_invitation
routes.description: Revoke an open invitation

routes.name: team.remove_member
routes.description: Remove a member (never yourself, never the last owner)

routes.name: team.update_member
routes.description: Change a member's role, permission overrides or status

routes.name: shop.resolve
routes.description: Map a hostname (a verified custom domain, or <slug>.<STOREFRONT_SUFFIX>) to the shop it belongs to

routes.name: shop.info
routes.description: The page chrome: theme, store identity, the built header (and its CSS), the basket's item count

routes.name: shop.cart
routes.description: The basket as money and as props (created on first use; the token in the response is the one to keep)

routes.name: shop.cart_add
routes.description: Put a variant in the basket (availability is a courtesy; the reservation at checkout is the guarantee)

routes.name: shop.cart_discount
routes.description: Apply a discount code, or clear it (an empty code). The refusal is written for a shopper and says something they can act on

routes.name: shop.cart_recover
routes.description: Restore an abandoned basket from the link in the recovery email: reopens the original cart and returns its token

routes.name: shop.cart_update
routes.description: Set a line's quantity (0 removes it)

routes.name: shop.checkout
routes.description: What the checkout form needs: the basket, shipping options for the destination, the payment provider

routes.name: shop.checkout_start
routes.description: Reserve stock, create the order and start the payment as one operation with a defined failure path; returns the provider URL to send the shopper to

routes.name: shop.checkout_return
routes.description: Confirm the order when the shopper comes back from the provider. Verifies rather than trusts: the provider's own answer decides, and it is idempotent

routes.name: shop.collections
routes.description: Published collections

routes.name: shop.collection
routes.description: One collection and its products (manual, or computed from its rules)

routes.name: shop.help_create
routes.description: A shopper asks a question: opens a ticket with its first message (no account; the ticket token is the capability)

routes.name: shop.help_show
routes.description: A ticket's conversation, with the realtime channel for live replies (this is also the page behind the link in the reply email)

routes.name: shop.help_reply
routes.description: A shopper follows up (this reopens the ticket)

routes.name: shop.home
routes.description: The homepage: always a block tree, through the same renderers the builder draws with (a store that never opened the builder gets the starter tree, live)

routes.name: shop.order
routes.description: A customer's view of their own order, by its own unguessable token

routes.name: shop.receipt
routes.description: The receipt for a paid order as a png or pdf: a short-lived signed URL to the file (refused until the order is paid: a receipt for money that has not arrived says something untrue)

routes.name: shop.page
routes.description: A page the merchant built

routes.name: shop.products
routes.description: The product listing (featured, newest or by title)

routes.name: shop.product
routes.description: One product: images, options, variants (stock shown as a number only when it is low enough to matter), SEO, related

routes.name: shop.robots
routes.description: robots.txt honouring the merchant's indexing choice (a store set to noindex gets a real Disallow: /)

routes.name: shop.sandbox_charge
routes.description: The sandbox provider's 'hosted page' data: what is being charged (only when SANDBOX_ENABLED)

routes.name: shop.sandbox_settle
routes.description: Decide a sandbox charge (succeeded or failed; default: the outcome the amount forces) and confirm the order

routes.name: shop.search
routes.description: Search products by title, summary or type

routes.name: shop.sitemap
routes.description: An XML sitemap of everything public (returned as {content_type, body} for the storefront host to serve)

routes.name: pages.list
routes.description: Every page this store has built

routes.name: pages.create
routes.description: Add a page (home and the two templates and header are singletons)

routes.name: pages.new_block
routes.description: A fresh block of a requested type, built on the server so it has exactly the shape sanitise will accept

routes.name: pages.publish_all
routes.description: Publish every page whose draft would change what is live (empty drafts are skipped, each page still gets its snapshot and audit entry)

routes.name: pages.new_section
routes.description: A section preset (a whole prebuilt band) drawn with this store's theme imagery

routes.name: pages.delete
routes.description: Delete a page (refused for the singletons)

routes.name: pages.show
routes.description: The builder's payload: the tree, the block registry, theme, palettes, section presets, pickable products/collections, real canvas data, revisions

routes.name: pages.save
routes.description: Autosave the draft: the tree is rebuilt from the registry, so nothing the browser invents is stored; answers with the server's version

routes.name: pages.publish
routes.description: Make the draft live

routes.name: pages.restore
routes.description: Put an earlier version back into the *draft* (never straight to live); what it replaces is snapshotted first, so a restore is undoable

routes.name: pages.unpublish
routes.description: Take a page off the storefront, keeping the draft (the published tree is cleared too, so it never says 'not published' while still serving)

routes.name: domains.list
routes.description: Domains, and what to publish in DNS to verify one

routes.name: domains.add
routes.description: Add a custom domain (pending until its TXT record is verified)

routes.name: domains.verify
routes.description: Check a custom domain's DNS (a real TXT lookup: an unverified domain stays unusable, or anyone could serve another merchant's shop from a hostname they control)

routes.name: storefront.upload_logo
routes.description: Upload the shop's logo (the same sniffing, size cap and storage as a product photograph)

routes.name: storefront.apply_palette
routes.description: Recolour the theme from a palette; no pages are touched

routes.name: seo.get
routes.description: SEO settings, canonical addresses, and how many products lack metadata

routes.name: seo.save
routes.description: Save SEO settings

routes.name: storefront.templates
routes.description: The template gallery: finished shops (only each homepage tree is sent; ten whole sites is most of a megabyte)

routes.name: storefront.apply_template
routes.description: Apply a template: its look, and (only if asked) its pages, as drafts

routes.name: storefront.template
routes.description: Every page of one template, as block trees, for the preview

routes.name: storefront.theme
routes.description: The store's theme as the storefront renders it (sanitised)

routes.name: storefront.save_theme
routes.description: Save the merchant's own theme edits (every value sanitised)

routes.name: support.list
routes.description: The inbox: tickets by status, with counts

routes.name: support.channel
routes.description: The realtime channel for this store's inbox. The channel name embeds a per-store secret that only a member with support.read is ever given

routes.name: support.show
routes.description: A ticket and its whole thread

routes.name: support.close
routes.description: Close a ticket (a shopper's follow-up reopens it)

routes.name: support.reply
routes.description: Answer a ticket (emails the shopper if they opted in)

buckets.name: media
buckets.description: Product images, logos and their derivatives. Public: product images are on a public storefront, and a signed URL on every would break browser caching for no security gain. Only the application writes.

buckets.name: exports
buckets.description: Finished CSV and Excel exports. Private: they hold customer names, emails and addresses, and are handed out as short-lived signed URLs after a permission check.

schedules.name: webhook-delivery
schedules.description: Send merchant webhook deliveries whose time has come.

schedules.name: abandoned-carts
schedules.description: Close out checkouts that were given up on: release their stock and record the recovery opportunity.

schedules.name: payment-reconciliation
schedules.description: Ask the provider about payments a webhook never resolved.

schedules.name: export-expiry
schedules.description: Delete finished export files past their retention window.

schedules.name: daily-analytics
schedules.description: Roll up the day that just closed (and the day before, for late webhooks) for every store.

schedules.name: campaign-scheduler
schedules.description: Start and finish campaigns whose window has arrived or passed.

schedules.name: export-runner
schedules.description: Run exports that were queued but whose job was lost (a restart).

inbound-hooks.name: Paystack
inbound-hooks.description: Paystack events (charge.success, refunds, transfers). Set this hook's secret to the platform's Paystack secret key: Paystack signs every delivery with it (HMAC-SHA512, x-paystack-signature).

inbound-hooks.name: Stripe
inbound-hooks.description: Stripe events. Registered but unoffered, as in the original.

inbound-hooks.name: Sandbox
inbound-hooks.description: The offline sandbox provider's test deliveries (demo and test environments only).

subscriptions.name: paystack-events
subscriptions.description: Handle a verified Paystack delivery exactly once.

roles.name: platform_admin
roles.description: People who run the platform itself (the original's is_superuser). Says nothing about what anyone may do inside a store: that is the store membership's job.
